ITEM 1 | Two rectangular pieces of flatbread-style crust with orange-red tomato sauce spread and melted white cheese on top, scattered with small browned spots and a few darker char marks; the cheese is soft and partly melted with slight sheen, crust edges golden-brown and firm, pieces lie side by side touching one corner, larger piece about 9 cm by 6 cm and smaller about 8 cm by 5 cm, sitting on a white square plate | 150

ITEM 2 | Sauce spots: deep red-orange tomato sauce concentrated as dark blotches on the cheese of the left piece, slightly glossy and moist, spread in irregular patches about 1 to 2 cm across | 10
